relay-controllable.description: True = the relay can be opened and closed by command or automatic shed. False = locked (for example a circuit commissioned as permanently on).

relay-requester.description: Source attribution for the last relay change: `USER`, `LOAD_SHED`, `PCS`, `CONFIGURATION`, `FAULT`, `NONE`, `UNKNOWN`. Publishers MAY extend via `$format`.

shared-with-device-ids.description: Comma-separated Homie device IDs of the other devices this relay also switches. Omitted when it switches only this device. See §"Shared switching hardware".
